'''Synnoran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the Cold War, Synnoran was stationed on Taris by her father [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Synnoran (Lord)|Synnoran]] to help recapture an outpost, however it turned out to be a [[rakghoul]] nest and the entire platoon was killed. Additionally someone had activated the outpost's self-destruct but it was stopped when power was lost.<ref name="TOR" />

Back at the [[75th Legion forward camp]] within the [[Tularan Marsh]], she met an Imperial spacer whom she asked for their help to reclaim the outpost.<ref name="TOR" />

She is the descendant of the "legendary" [[Darth Synn]].
